title: Silas and the Signal
author: Cyrus Reyes
blurb: Ansel Nystrom, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
